name: es_excel_cp1252
about: Spanish spreadsheet export: cp1252, CRLF, semicolons, 1.234,56 amounts, s/d gaps, padded values, one duplicate row.

name: es_excel_cp1252_gates
about: The same export through quality gates: a duplicate row, a missing amount and a missing Total column fail; Unidades passes.

name: utf8_bom_events
about: UTF-8 with BOM: date-times with offsets compared as instants, booleans in two cases, padded header names.

name: tab_quoted
about: Tab separated with quoted fields that contain newlines, commas and tabs, and an exact duplicate record.

name: ports_pipe_gzip
about: Pipe separated and gzip-compressed, detected from content.

name: mostly_typed
about: Stray values (N/A, 12a, pendiente) keep qty and ship_date as text; type hints name them and --require-type fails.

name: utf8_bom_events_ranges
about: Date-times with offsets through --range: compared as instants, events written at 08:00-04:00 and 09:15+02:00 are exactly 12:00 and 07:15 UTC and pass, which a wall-clock comparison would fail; a temperature of -3 fails 0:30.

name: erp_day_first
about: Day-first ERP export: dates and date-times read with --date-order dmy next to ISO values; an impossible due date (30/02/2026) blocks the date type and is named.

name: excel_es_booleans
about: Spanish Excel 'CSV UTF-8' export: BOM, CRLF, VERDADERO/FALSO and Sí/No flags read with --bool-words; one 'Pendiente' keeps Enviado as text, is named in the type hint and fails --require-type.

name: excel_sep_hint
about: Excel export that starts with a sep=; line: the line is skipped, the declared semicolon is used instead of detection, and cp1252 names, grouped stock and day-first dates are read.

name: excel_sep_hint_wrong_delimiter
about: The same file with the default comma: the tool stops and names the declared delimiter instead of producing a one-column report.

name: py_invoices_affixes
about: Invoice export with currency symbols, units and percentages: amounts become numbers, and the per-column affix counts show guaraníes mixed with dollars and one weight in pounds; 'a convenir' keeps the discount as text.

name: py_invoices_affixes_gates
about: The same invoices through --max-affixes: amounts in two currencies and weights in two units fail, discounts with one affix pass.

name: erp_balances_sap
about: Trial balance from an ERP: negative balances written with a trailing minus (84.300,50-) and in parentheses ((9.870,00)) are read as negative numbers with --accounting-negatives.

name: erp_balances_sap_ranges
about: The trial balance through --range: debits and credits are never negative and pass; a balance of -310.000,00 is outside the expected range; a text column cannot be checked against numbers.

name: py_invoices_next_day
about: The next export of the same invoices, compared with the report of the first one: Descuento was dropped, Moneda appeared, 'a confirmar' turned Monto into text and many weights are blank; the schema changes fail the run.

name: py_invoices_next_day_drift
about: The same pair through the drift gates: the row count rose, so --max-row-drop passes; Peso went from 12.5% to 44.44% missing, 31.94 points more, so --max-missing-increase fails.

name: py_invoices_next_day_drift_columns
about: The same pair with a per-column drift limit: no column may lose values (0 points), except Peso, whose 31.94-point rise is within its own 35-point limit, so the run passes.

name: courier_shipments_unique
about: Courier export where tracking codes repeat in rows that differ elsewhere (a re-sent parcel, a padded code): --max-duplicates passes, --unique Guía fails with 3 repeated cells, Pedido is unique; the s/d and empty codes are missing, not repeats.

name: erp_invoice_lines_unique_key
about: ERP invoice lines whose invoice numbers restart in each branch: no row repeats and every column repeats on its own. Factura,Línea fails with 5 rows because branches share numbers; Sucursal,Factura,Línea finds the one line exported twice with another amount (and a padded invoice number); the row without a line number is skipped.

name: stock_counts_week1
about: Weekly stock count of a distributor (semicolons, decimal comma): whole-unit quantities, numeric lot codes and count dates; the baseline of the next three cases.

name: stock_counts_week2_schema
about: The next week's count, compared with the first: bulk items counted in kilos turn Cantidad into float, counts now carry a time (date -> datetime) and lot codes such as L-0042 turn Lote into text; --fail-on-schema-change counts 3 changes.

name: stock_counts_week2_allowed
about: The same pair with --allow-type-change for the two widenings (int:float only in Cantidad, date:datetime in any column): they are tolerated and listed, while Lote int -> string still fails the run.

name: stock_counts_week2_allowed_columns
about: The same rules on the columns a consumer reads (--columns leaves Lote out): both type changes are allowed, nothing else changed, so the schema gate passes and still lists what it tolerated.

name: stock_counts_week1_stamped
about: The first count profiled with --record-time on a fixed clock (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, 2026-10-05T22:00:00Z): the report carries generated_at; the stamped baseline of the next two cases.

name: stock_counts_week2_fresh_baseline
about: The weekly job a week later (2026-10-12T12:00:00Z) with --max-baseline-age 8d: the baseline is 6 days 14 hours old, so the check passes; the comparison shows when the baseline was generated.

name: stock_counts_week2_stale_baseline
about: The same comparison two weeks later (2026-10-19T12:00:00Z), as when a pipeline stops refreshing its baseline: 13 days 14 hours is over the 8-day limit, so the run fails.

name: stock_counts_week2_unstamped_baseline
about: The age gate on a baseline written without --record-time: its age cannot be known (the file's modification time is never used), so the check fails and says how to stamp it.

name: stock_counts_week3_schema
about: Three weeks later the ERP export was upgraded: it adds a Unidad column and lot codes moved to another export (Lote is gone); compared with the first count, --fail-on-schema-change counts 2 changes.

name: stock_counts_week3_allowed_added
about: The same pair with --allow-added-column Unidad: the new column is tolerated and listed, while the removed Lote still fails the run.

name: stock_counts_week3_allowed
about: Both column changes allowed by name (--allow-added-column Unidad, --allow-removed-column Lote): nothing else changed, so the schema gate passes and lists what it tolerated; the baseline comparison still shows both columns.

name: erp_day_first_max_age
about: Freshness of the day-first ERP export on 2026-02-17T23:55:00Z, its times at -04:00: the last dispatch (14/02/2026 15:55, 19:55 UTC) is 3 days 4 hours old and fails --max-age Despacho=2d; the last issue date (14/02/2026, which lasts until 04:00 UTC on the 15th) is 2 days 19 hours 55 minutes old and passes Emisión=3d.

name: stock_counts_week1_max_age_no_offset
about: --max-age on dates written without a UTC offset and no --utc-offset: the time zone is never guessed, so the check fails and says how to give the offset.

name: erp_header_only_min_rows
about: An ERP export that failed half-way and wrote only its header (semicolons, CRLF): nothing is missing, repeated or out of range, so every other gate passes; --min-rows 1 fails it with 0 data rows.

name: courier_shipments_allowed_values
about: The courier's status column checked against the statuses the consumer handles: the returned parcel (Devuelto) is the one cell outside the list, so the run fails and names it.

name: ar_customers_pattern
about: A customer master export checked for the format of its codes: two tax ids written without dashes or with spaces, and two postal codes cut to five characters, fail their patterns; the padded tax id and the s/d and empty cells are not counted.
